datum.name: Iteration 002 robot frame = taps-02 root: chassis centre on the factory-tire floor (Z = 0), +X toward the reef (delivery) face, +Y port, +Z up, millimetres

narrativeReview.read: Read end to end on 2026-11-22: LEAVE, two TELEOP station-to-L1 cycles in sectors A and B, custody, trough release and support, park, the endgame choice and the empty-start fallback.

objectives.objective: AUTO: leave the starting line with the whole occupied robot (3 points)
objectives.basis: A field-route objective for the empty robot; this package reserves the stowed starting configuration (886.7 mm tall, lip inside the perimeter) and deploys the lip at match start (lip-deploy) but places no starting-line fixture.

objectives.objective: TELEOP: take one station-issued CORAL from the red station
objectives.basis: Cases receive-01-station-chute to receive-16-seat follow the receive-mission trial from the registered station chute to the carry seat; G1 receive trials 108/108; premises station-receive-face, station-feed-speed and receive-captive-time.

objectives.objective: Carry it to the red reef while crossing peer routes
objectives.basis: The drive-away and brake cases of the receive-mission trial (3 m/s2), the 6 m/s2 receive-and-go runs and the sled trials at 1-8 g both ways; weak-pack voltage premise. A frontal hit on the lip is the sprung-stop case service-lip-over-travel. Peer routing itself is a field-rehearsal question.

objectives.objective: Sustain a deliverable load: keep custody when accelerating, braking or contacted, and detect displacement or loss
objectives.basis: Sled trials: powered 72/72, disabled 18/18 retained; the seated-pipe beam, flap-closed switch and lip-deployed switch are selected and placed. Power off: case carry-01-power-off-hit follows the custody-power-off-hit trial; 24/24 required stop and hit cases retained on the squeeze alone. Physical retention and detection are bench gates G3, G5 and G7.

objectives.objective: Release into the intended L1 trough sector A, clear the wall and leave the pipe supported after withdrawal
objectives.basis: Cases eject-01-nip to eject-07-trough follow the eject-nominal trial into the placed trough; G2 ejects 480/480 captured and supported 2 s after a 120 mm withdrawal at every 0-100 mm stand-off, with latch-failed, disabled, lip-removed, short-lip and 125 mm controls.

objectives.objective: Return for a second station CORAL and score it in sector B with the first pipe as an obstacle
objectives.basis: The cycle resets (empty pocket, lip stays deployed). The first pipe at its rest pose is a fixture of every eject case; second-trip.json gives the lateral budget (+/-70 mm, premise lateral-dock-error) and the same-section control. The sector divider is not modelled; G4 measures the dock scatter.

objectives.objective: PARK: reserve the south lane, stow, reach the zone and stop
objectives.basis: Case withdraw-park; the lip stays deployed (it has no in-match stow), which the park envelope and R105 premise both include.

objectives.objective: Endgame alternatives: shallow or deep CAGE

objectives.basis: The same robot with no pipe aboard; lip-deploy and withdraw-park need no pipe.

objectives.objective: Partner and station dependence: Red 1 station change and station depletion
objectives.basis: An alliance-chain comparison owned by conceptual design; it changes no package volume.

premises.scenario: Both TELEOP station receives at the red station, receiving face toward the station
Station feed: largest pipe speed before the check flap, released from rest on the registered chute, dock gap 0-50 mm
Station receive dwell: check flap closed behind the pipe plus the 50 ms flap-switch latency, after which the robot may leave
Sector A and B docks: bumper face to trough lip 0-100 mm (evaluation dock scatter); eject captured and supported 2 s at every stand-off
Second trip: lateral dock error allowed at each reef sector so the second pipe lands beside the first, not on it
Installed tread stiffness per roller at the 6 mm squeeze (design nominal until bench gate G0 measures it)
Seated pipe with the main power off: largest 0.5 s deceleration into the nip retained at the softest accepted tread
R103 heavy single-contingency estimate of the inspected configuration
Every cycle stage on the weak 11.8 V / 32 mOhm pack at the conservative simultaneous current
552-r5 electronics placements, battery gauge and wiring reserves under the pocket
R105: the deployed lip is the only extension; projection beyond the frame (robot) perimeter for the whole match
R102: starting configuration with the lip stowed; no robot reserve beyond the front frame face (bumpers excluded)
R104: starting height of every robot reserve
G412: eject only with a bumper partially in our reef zone, established by the reef range sensor

criterion.equals: reef range <= 100 mm stand-off AND seated-pipe beam blocked AND lip-deployed switch closed

premises.value: reef range <= 100 mm stand-off AND seated-pipe beam blocked AND lip-deployed switch closed

premises.scenario: Selected scoring architecture for this package: fixed pocket, powered-hold nip, deploy-once 100 mm lip
Carried-forward iteration 002 chassis as a revisable premise of this layout, not a fixed boundary
Four tapped nutbar holes and seated 1/4-20 x 1 in screws as a revisable premise
Electronics, wiring, battery tray and battery service paths carried from the pan baseline as revisable premises

lip-deploy.basis: Prescribed hinge rotation, not a trial trace: at match start the servo pin releases the upright stowed lip and its torsion spring and gravity swing it 120 deg onto the sprung deployed stop in 0.17 s (structure-checks.json L8, a rigid-body integration); the pipe is still in the station
lip-deploy.allowanceBasis: 2.0 mm reserve between distinct reserves: fabrication and working-load deflection of polycarbonate and 1/4 in plate; every mated face is partitioned at 2.1 mm. The roller treads are reserved by their rigid core. Each contact the trial solves in a case (pipe on the tray, flap, lip, station chute or trough) is declared as that case's intended interface and bound to evidence/interfaces; every other pair keeps the reserve along the trial path

receive-chute.basis: The station-issued pipe, released from rest, rolls down the official station chute, leaves the sill and drops toward the robot inlet. One motion along the solved trace receive-mission of field-trials.json, 0.000-0.656 s, through the poses draft 4 checked as receive-01 to receive-03 (at most 4.84 mm from the solved path).
receive-chute.allowanceBasis: 2.0 mm reserve between distinct reserves: fabrication and working-load deflection of polycarbonate and 1/4 in plate; every mated face is partitioned at 2.1 mm. The roller treads are reserved by their rigid core. Each contact the trial solves in a case (pipe on the tray, flap, lip, station chute or trough) is declared as that case's intended interface and bound to evidence/interfaces; every other pair keeps the reserve along the trial path

pipe.basis: The pipe is in free flight between the station and the inlet

receive-pocket.basis: The pipe lands on the inlet, rolls down the 15.74 deg floor, pushes the check flap open, meets the held nip and the flap closes behind it: captive, and the flap-closed switch releases the robot 50 ms later. One motion through the eight solved poses of receive-mission, 0.656-1.064 s, with the flap turning from the same trace (draft 4's receive-04 to receive-10; at most 6.52 mm from the solved path).

drive.pocket tray: Gravity on the fixed inlet chute and floor
drive.check flap: Spring check flap: the pipe pushes it open; closed, its rear stop holds the pipe
drive.lower nip roller: Held by the powered position hold: NEO 550 through the MAXPlanetary 36:1, 30 A limit
drive.upper nip roller: Held by the powered position hold: NEO 550 through the MAXPlanetary 36:1, 30 A limit, through the coupling belt

pipe.basis: The pipe rebounds between the held nip and the closed flap

leave-station.basis: The robot accelerates toward the reef at 3 m/s2, cruises and brakes; the pipe rides back against the closed flap and rolls forward into the held nip. One motion along receive-mission, 1.064-2.564 s (draft 4's receive-11 to receive-14; at most 5.75 mm from the solved path). The stop is its own motion because the battery duty changes: driving, then holding at rest.
leave-station.allowanceBasis: 2.0 mm reserve between distinct reserves: fabrication and working-load deflection of polycarbonate and 1/4 in plate; every mated face is partitioned at 2.1 mm. The roller treads are reserved by their rigid core. Each contact the trial solves in a case (pipe on the tray, flap, lip, station chute or trough) is declared as that case's intended interface and bound to evidence/interfaces; every other pair keeps the reserve along the trial path

drive.upper nip roller: Held by the powered position hold: NEO 550 through the MAXPlanetary 36:1, 30 A limit, through the coupling belt

pipe.basis: Braking rolls the pipe down the floor into the bite

seat-pipe.basis: The robot is stopped; the pipe settles on its carry seat and the seated-pipe beam is blocked. One motion along receive-mission, 2.564-2.752 s (draft 4's receive-15 and receive-16; at most 0.04 mm from the solved path).
seat-pipe.allowanceBasis: 2.0 mm reserve between distinct reserves: fabrication and working-load deflection of polycarbonate and 1/4 in plate; every mated face is partitioned at 2.1 mm. drive.upper nip roller: Held by the powered position hold: NEO 550 through the MAXPlanetary 36:1, 30 A limit, through the coupling belt

pipe.basis: The pipe settles in the bite of the held nip

carry-power-off-hit.basis: Carrying with the main power off, the robot is hit: 8 g for 50 ms drives the pipe into the unpowered nip; the squeeze stops it and returns it to the seat. One motion out and back along trace custody-power-off-hit, 0.000-1.600 s (draft 4's carry-01 and carry-02; at most 3.46 mm from the solved path).
carry-power-off-hit.allowanceBasis: 2.0 mm reserve between distinct reserves: fabrication and working-load deflection of polycarbonate and 1/4 in plate; every mated face is partitioned at 2.1 mm. The roller treads are reserved by their rigid core. Each contact the trial solves in a case (pipe on the tray, flap, lip, station chute or trough) is declared as that case's intended interface and bound to evidence/interfaces; every other pair keeps the reserve along the trial path

drive.pocket tray: Gravity on the fixed pocket floor
drive.lower nip roller: Unpowered: the 6 mm tread squeeze holds the pipe and the coasting gearbox adds only its inertia
drive.upper nip roller: Unpowered, coupled to the lower shaft by the belt

pipe.basis: The pipe climbs part of the tread squeeze and rolls back to its seat with no power on the nip

eject-nip.basis: Docked at the reef, the interlock passes and the nip draws the pipe through the 12 mm squeeze (roller cores stay 3 mm clear), over the driven lower roller onto the deployed lip and down its ramp to the tip. One motion along trace eject-nominal, 0.000-0.216 s (draft 4's eject-01 and eject-02; at most 6.37 mm from the solved path).
eject-nip.allowanceBasis: 2.0 mm reserve between distinct reserves: fabrication and working-load deflection of polycarbonate and 1/4 in plate; every mated face is partitioned at 2.1 mm. The roller treads are reserved by their rigid core. Each contact the trial solves in a case (pipe on the tray, flap, lip, station chute or trough) is declared as that case's intended interface and bound to evidence/interfaces; every other pair keeps the reserve along the trial path

drive.lower nip roller: NEO 550 through the MAXPlanetary 36:1 at 12 V open loop, 30 A limit
drive.upper nip roller: Counter-rotated from the lower shaft by the coupling belt
drive.exit lip: Gravity on the deployed 30 deg ramp and land

pipe.basis: The driven lower roller hands the pipe to the deployed lip, which it rolls down

eject-trough.basis: The pipe leaves the lip tip, drops into the trough, runs to the riser and rolls back to rest against the outer lip. One motion along eject-nominal, 0.216-1.432 s (draft 4's eject-03 to eject-07; at most 5.69 mm from the solved path).
eject-trough.allowanceBasis: 2.0 mm reserve between distinct reserves: fabrication and working-load deflection of polycarbonate and 1/4 in plate; every mated face is partitioned at 2.1 mm. The roller treads are reserved by their rigid core. Each contact the trial solves in a case (pipe on the tray, flap, lip, station chute or trough) is declared as that case's intended interface and bound to evidence/interfaces; every other pair keeps the reserve along the trial path

pipe.basis: The pipe is in the field's trough: no robot mechanism touches it

withdraw-park.basis: Prescribed robot drive, not a mechanism trial: the robot backs 300 mm away and parks with the lip deployed and the pocket empty; in the robot frame the scored pipe and the trough recede together. The eject trials withdraw the first 120 mm at 0.3 m/s and assess the pipe 2 s after it is again at rest
withdraw-park.allowanceBasis: 2.0 mm packaging reserve between parked reserves, the same partition as operation

service-hood-withdrawal.basis: Full service withdrawal: the hood, check flap and flap-closed switch lifted straight up 1260 mm, above everything in the checked scene (the official reef branch reaches 1.83 m). Interference only (0 mm reserve): the official field parts are closer to each other than 2.0 mm where FIRST joins them and an extraction case may declare no interface. service-hood-lift checks the first 400 mm of the same lift with the 2.0 mm reserve
service-hood-withdrawal.allowanceBasis: 2.0 mm clearance for hand, tool and withdrawal paths around conservative envelopes; mated faces partitioned at 2.1 mm

service-hood-lift.basis: Pit unload, step 1: release the thumb screws and lift the hood, with the check flap on its pin and the flap-closed switch on its top, 400 mm: clear of the whole robot after 320 mm. It is then set down beside the robot, where the later service cases show it
service-hood-lift.allowanceBasis: 2.0 mm clearance for hand, tool and withdrawal paths around conservative envelopes; mated faces partitioned at 2.1 mm

service-unload-pipe.basis: Pit unload, step 2, with the hood set down beside the robot: roll the unscored pipe back up the floor and lift it out on one hand arc (110 deg about an axis 250 mm along the seat normal), clear of the upper roller and above the robot, then 150 mm straight up
service-unload-pipe.allowanceBasis: 2.0 mm clearance for hand, tool and withdrawal paths around conservative envelopes; mated faces partitioned at 2.1 mm

service-nip-cassette-lift.basis: With the hood and pipe out and set down beside the robot, unbolt the two side plates from the upper stringers and lift the nip cassette (plates, rollers, drive, belt, latch, sensors and deployed lip) 520 mm: clear of the inlet walls after 480 mm
service-nip-cassette-lift.allowanceBasis: 2.0 mm clearance for hand, tool and withdrawal paths around conservative envelopes; mated faces partitioned at 2.1 mm

service-lip-restow.basis: Between matches, with the pocket emptied (hood and pipe set down beside the robot): fold the deployed lip 120 deg up by hand and set the latch pin (the deploy-once reset)
service-lip-restow.allowanceBasis: 2.0 mm clearance for hand, tool and withdrawal paths around conservative envelopes; mated faces partitioned at 2.1 mm

service-lip-over-travel.basis: Sprung-stop over-travel: a frontal hit turns the deployed lip a further 31.2 deg down against its stop springs until the bumper carries the load (structure-checks.json L5); the empty lip must clear every neighbour through that swing
service-lip-over-travel.allowanceBasis: 2.0 mm clearance for hand, tool and withdrawal paths around conservative envelopes; mated faces partitioned at 2.1 mm

service-battery-lift.basis: After unplugging, lift the dressed battery 250 mm through the centre gap between the equipment sheets; the hand that unplugged it keeps hold of the battery-side plug and rises with it
service-battery-lift.allowanceBasis: 2.0 mm clearance for hand, tool and withdrawal paths around conservative envelopes; mated faces partitioned at 2.1 mm

service-battery-rear-carry.basis: Continue from the 250 mm lift rearward under the inlet chute and over the rear bumper until clear, the hand still on the plug. In the pit no station stands behind the robot: the station fixtures, which every case must list, start 1500 mm rearward
service-battery-rear-carry.allowanceBasis: 2.0 mm clearance for hand, tool and withdrawal paths around conservative envelopes; mated faces partitioned at 2.1 mm

service-plug-disconnect.basis: A hand reaches down to grip the SB50 pair from above
service-plug-disconnect.allowanceBasis: 2.0 mm clearance for hand, tool and withdrawal paths around conservative envelopes; mated faces partitioned at 2.1 mm

service-breaker-reset.basis: A hand reaches the CB185 reset button outboard of the pocket walls
service-breaker-reset.allowanceBasis: 2.0 mm clearance for hand, tool and withdrawal paths around conservative envelopes; mated faces partitioned at 2.1 mm
